title: Highly recommend!
text: Veronica did an absolutely amazing job on my son’s senior pictures in the Plaza de España. She was great at communicating the time and place beforehand and the pictures came out so beautifully. We are so happy with the results and plan to return to do my daughter’s senior pics in a few years!

title: Easy to book and...
text: Easy to book and communicate. They knew all the best spots, guided us efficiently, and captured incredible photos. Highly recommend!
author: Guillermo_J

title: Wonderful experience and beautiful photos
text:
Veronia was an absolute pleasure to work with. She was kind, professional, and made the entire process feel seamless and comfortable from start to finish.

She guided us effortlessly during the shoot, which made a big difference, and the whole experience felt relaxed and enjoyable. We’re so happy with how the photos turned out — they’ve come out beautifully and are such a special reminder of our time.

Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a photographer!
author: Sush_S

title: Highly recommended!
text: What a great experience. My wife and I wanted to make our 25th wedding anniversary extra special by making memories that would last. Verónica is an excellent photographer and host, who knows all the best angels around the Plaze de España! Time flew by and the pictures turned out great. And we even had a rainbow in some of the shots! Highly recommended!
author: 683jeroenv

title: Engagement shoot with Veronica
text: Veronica was an absolute joy to work with! She was a consummate professional, very fun, very knowledgeable about the area and lighting, and made us both feel beautiful. Even the pictures that weren’t part of the original set were absolutely fantastic, and she let us have a say in how we posed and where we shot. We had an absolute blast, and would strongly recommend Veronica to anybody doing an engagement shoot, or any other type of picture taking.
author: Evan_S

title: Amazing experience!
text: Véronica was the most amazing photographer and certainly knew what she was doing! We purchased ALL pictures (not just the ones included in the price) because each and every single one is beautiful! Highly recommendable!
